releases.name: Dashboard dashboard-v0.20.14
releases.body:
## Fixed

- Broca sessions that record a client message id, or that waited for a compaction provider before a prompt rewrite, are read in full. Before this release, the dashboard stopped reading such a session at the first record that used either feature.

# v0.49.19

This patch release fixes Pi and Oh My Pi on Bun 1.3.x, `ctx_expand` by tag in Rust transform mode, dreamer runs stuck on a model that never answers, four edge cases of the signed-thinking hold, and a migration risk on Bun 1.4.4.

## Upgrading

- **No migration.** `context.db` stays at schema 95 and `store.db` at schema 63. Restart OpenCode 1, OpenCode 2, Pi or Oh My Pi after updating.

## Fixed

- Pi and Oh My Pi running on Bun 1.3.x (Oh My Pi's documented minimum is Bun 1.3.14) no longer refuse every turn on long sessions after 10 seconds. Bun releases before 1.4 hold back every message to a background worker until the worker's startup code has finished, and the worker that loads a session's tags waited for such a message during startup, so it never finished. Semantic auto-search hints had the same problem on that Bun and always came back empty; they now return matches again. Bun 1.4 and Node were not affected (issue 754, thanks @ChenYCL for the report and the investigation).
- In Rust transform mode, `ctx_expand` with a tag number now refuses and points to expanding by message or range, instead of returning an unrelated old item. Tag numbers in Rust mode come from the module's own store and can repeat numbers left over from before the session switched modes. TypeScript mode, Pi and Oh My Pi are unchanged.
- On OpenCode 1, a dreamer task whose primary model never produces any output (for example a free model that has stopped answering) now moves to the configured fallback model after 90 seconds of silence, instead of holding the run for up to 20 minutes and then failing. This applies to classification, memory mapping and verification, and only when a fallback model is configured. A model that is answering, however slowly, keeps its full time.
- Four edge cases of the hold on Claude models whose thinking is bound to the prompt prefix:
  - With compaction turned off, the first request after a restart could put a new prompt head in front of the open turn's signed thinking. That thinking is now removed from the request when the head may have changed, on OpenCode 1, OpenCode 2, Pi and Oh My Pi.
  - After a restart, messages that a recovered request had sent untagged stay untagged until a pass that may rewrite the prompt anyway, so a deferred pass after the restart sends the same bytes.
  - When a session has been idle past its cache lifetime while the open turn's signed thinking is held, the date in the system prompt is no longer advanced on that request; it advances on the first request that doesn't keep the held thinking.
  - The refusal that keeps an oversized request from going out with held signed thinking now applies only to requests that actually hold it. Other requests are sized and refused the same way as for any other model.
- Upgrading on Bun 1.4.4 no longer risks memory and note writes failing if an upgrade stops partway through the database migrations.

releases.name: Dashboard dashboard-v0.20.13
releases.body:
## Dashboard 0.20.13

- Reads Broca session logs that carry the new structured-output paragraph setting, so runs from Broca's next release keep showing their steps and usage.

# v0.49.18

This patch release fixes a repeated cache bust after cleanup on OpenCode 2, false dispatch refusals on Oh My Pi, tag numbering around file attachments, section references in the tag cleaner, compaction during long Claude turns, and context sizing on the first pass after a host restart.

## Upgrading

- **No migration.** `context.db` stays at schema 95 and `store.db` at schema 63. Restart OpenCode 1, OpenCode 2, Pi or Oh My Pi after updating.

## Fixed

- On OpenCode 2, a cleanup pass is no longer followed by a second cache bust on the next request: instruction rows already covered by the history summary are now served on every pass, so the pass after a cleanup sends the same bytes (issue 750, thanks @null-axiom).
- Pi and Oh My Pi no longer refuse valid requests with `comparison=role` when a tool call was interrupted by another message. The dispatch check now models the host moving the tool result forward into the call's window, but only on providers where Oh My Pi itself does that (issue 751, thanks @Zireael).
- New OpenCode file attachments no longer take a tag number, so the next visible number the model sees is the one its reply gets. Token totals for messages that mix text and files are also corrected in the sidebar and in protected-tail sizing.
- The tag cleaner no longer drops the leading digit of a section reference such as `§12.3`. A session with a text part that starts with such a reference has its prompt cache rewritten once, from that part on, the first time this version serves it.
- Long autonomous turns on Claude models whose thinking is bound to the prompt prefix now compact at the normal threshold, instead of staying at 85-99% until the next user message. Compaction is held only right after heavy reasoning, on OpenCode 1, OpenCode 2, Pi and Oh My Pi (issue 729, thanks @moynzzz).
- After a host restart, the first pass no longer sizes context usage with the fit-check estimate, which could double the reading for models missing from the tokenizer calibration table and land queued or emergency drops on a pass that should have deferred (issue 752, thanks @Sugaroverdose).

## Docs

- The configuration reference's context-management section now explains that a `cache_ttl` shorter than the provider's real cache lifetime (for example a locally hosted model whose prefix cache doesn't expire) makes idle expiry rebuild onto a cache that is still warm, so `cache_ttl` should match the provider.

releases.name: Dashboard dashboard-v0.20.12
releases.body:
## Dashboard 0.20.12

### Fixed
- Broca sessions that record per-part tags in the new `runner-tags/v2` format now open and show their steps instead of being treated as written by a newer, unknown version.

issues.title: pi dispatch fence: piPreparedStructure rejects MC's own leading system injection (m0/m1), refusing every injected turn
Compaction boundary absent from the in-memory message list → prefix trim defers forever with no recovery; pressure escalation frozen on incremental event-payload usage
opencode plugins: V2 primary-session prompt hangs when @cortexkit/opencode-magic-context@0.42.6 is loaded
v0.34.0 migration guard can falsely block DB migration after Linux PID reuse
hidden-completion: dreamer & smart-note LLM tasks refused with hidden_prompt_unrecognized on OpenCode 2.0.21 (plugin 0.44.4, not #566)
Marker-only assistant replies (`§N§ [dropped §N§]`, `[cleared]`) escape placeholder neutralization and stall OpenCode 2 sessions
